program.name: Active Flexibility
program.subject: Flexibility
program.blurb: Stretch, then use it: held stretches followed by control drills that own the new range.
program.about: Flexibility you can use, not just reach. Each session holds a few long stretches, then follows them with a circuit of control drills, hip airplanes, 90/90s, wall slides, that make the new range strong. Two days alternate legs and shoulders. Level II holds the stretches longer and Level III adds reps to the drills.
